name: ugv_approach_final3.1
prompt:
PHYSICAL SIMULATION: GROUND ROBOT APPROACH. 

[SETUP]: The input image contains a grey wheeled UGV (Unmanned Ground Vehicle) on an office carpet. 
[CAMERA STATE]: The camera is a STATIC TRIPOD fixed at floor level. CAMERA VELOCITY = 0. The background walls and furniture are FROZEN and do not move.
[ACTION VECTOR]: The UGV robot pivots 180 degrees to face the lens. It then accelerates along the Z-AXIS directly towards the static camera position. 
[OUTCOME]: The robot stays on the ground (planar movement) and gets significantly larger in the frame as it closes the distance to the viewer.
negative_prompt: drone, aerial flight, hovering, camera dolly, camera moving forward, zooming camera, floating robot, flying robot, distorted wheels, morphing shape, shaky camera, motion blur on background, changing background geometry.
